facts.value: Undergraduate degree-seeking students who previously attended ASU but have not been enrolled for up to seven consecutive fall or spring semesters.
No need to submit a new application or application fee.
Sign in to My ASU and register for classes.
There may be a hold or Priority Task that needs to be completed before registration.
The catalog year upon re-entry will be determined via current policy.
International students are responsible for all SEVIS requirements and should check with the International Students and Scholars Center.
If absence is due to military deployment, service on an official church mission, foreign aid service, or permanent disability, a Leave of Absence must be submitted.
Official transcripts from all institutions attended during absence must be submitted directly to Admission Services.
Transcripts must be mailed or sent electronically by the records office and cannot be sent or carried by hand by applicants themselves or transmitted by fax.
International students eligible for quick re-entry should contact ASU's International Students and Scholars Center to submit documentation for issuance of an I-20.
Visit issc.asu.edu for more information regarding international students.
Students who have completed an ASU bachelor's degree program or were academically disqualified are not eligible for quick re-entry.
